errors.evidence: The description omits the title of the chart, "Qwen2-7B on Songs", which is essential context for understanding what model and dataset the metrics refer to.

The description uses the awkward and mixed-language phrase "QA performance/accuracy". The legend clearly labels the metric as "Accuracy". While "QA performance" is mentioned in the paper's caption, combining them with a slash is unclear and stylistically poor.

The description states there is a data point for the 'Accuracy' line at an x-value of 10. However, the plot does not contain a data point at x=10 for any of the lines. The data points are at discrete, non-uniform intervals on the x-axis, with points at x=9 and x=12, but not at x=10.
